findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: freedom_stealth_unlocker, freedom_captcha_solver, freedom_structured_extractor, freedom_clean_scraper, freedom_clearinghouse_orderbook, freedom_llm_inference, freedom_prepaid_session_pass · Private data: freedom_captcha_solver, freedom_structured_extractor, freedom_agent_memory, freedom_llm_inference, freedom_prepaid_session_pass · Public sink: freedom_captcha_solver, freedom_clearinghouse_orderbook, freedom_register_agent_skill, freedom_hire_verified_worker, freedom_prepaid_session_pass · Destructive: freedom_agent_memory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: freedom_stealth_unlocker, freedom_captcha_solver, freedom_structured_extractor, freedom_clean_scraper, freedom_clearinghouse_orderbook, freedom_llm_inference, freedom_prepaid_session_pass · Private data: freedom_captcha_solver, freedom_structured_extractor, freedom_agent_memory, freedom_llm_inference, freedom_prepaid_session_pass · Public sink: freedom_captcha_solver, freedom_clearinghouse_orderbook, freedom_register_agent_skill, freedom_hire_verified_worker, freedom_prepaid_session_pass · Destructive: freedom_agent_memory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
